author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದುಳಿವಿಗೇ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯ ಕಾದಾಟ
ಮಸ್ತಿಷ್ಕವಿರಲಲ್ಲಿ ಮನುಜತ್ವದುಳಿವು
ಸುಸ್ಥಿತಿಯ ಜಗವೆಮಗೆ ಗುರಿಯಾಗೆ ಬದುಕಿನಲಿ
ದುಸ್ತರವ ನೀಗಿನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Every day is a fight to keep existing;
where there is a mind, humanity survives;
when a well-ordered world is our goal in life,
walk on, overcoming what is hard to cross, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life is a daily struggle to survive, but a thinking mind keeps our humanity alive. Aim for a better world and push through the hardest obstacles.
